title: Painted Heart Ritual
description: A surreal night scene shows a glowing multicolored heart dripping paint onto a green wooden table. On the table are two bottles spilling yellow, red, and blue paint that cascades down. Behind the table stands a gothic church on the left and a decorated Christmas tree on the right, with a skeletal grim reaper figure floating above between them. The foreground contains grass and flowers while the background features wisteria-covered trees under a teal and black sky with mountains.
prompt: Surreal night scene with a large glowing heart in red blue and yellow dripping paint onto a green wooden table. Two bottles on the table spill vibrant primary colors that cascade down the sides. To the left a gothic church covered in purple wisteria, to the right a Christmas tree with colorful ornaments. A skeletal grim reaper in a red robe floats above the heart. Foreground has glowing grass and flowers, background shows wisteria trees against a dark teal sky with grey mountains. Vibrant dripping paint effects, high contrast, illustrative style.
